messages:
maya: FYI I kicked off the int4 bring-up for rwd-v6p today, canary at 1% by default. want to sync on automatic fallback thresholds before we ramp.

lucas: Thanks. initial smoke looked OK but noticed ~0.01 MRR dip on small long-doc slice in shadow. not huge but visible.

anya: Can we codify auto-fallback rules? Last time we rolled fast and had to rollback manually, burned cycles.

sam: +1 on automating. My proposal: three primary signals — delta_mrr, hallucination_rate_ratio, latency_p95_ratio. Any one crossing hard thresholds triggers a soft-fallback; persistent violation triggers full rollback.

maya: Sketching config below — open to tweaks:
```yaml
rollout:
  strategy: staged
  initial: 1%
  steps: [1, 3, 7, 15, 30]
  step_interval: 20m
  metrics:
    delta_mrr_warn: -0.01  # soft warning
    delta_mrr_hard: -0.02  # immediate soft-fallback
    halluc_ratio_warn: 1.15
    halluc_ratio_hard: 1.4
    p95_latency_ratio_hard: 1.25
  hysteresis: 30m # require sustained violation over this window
  fallback_policy: 
    soft: route-to:int8-bridge
    hard: rollback-to:previous
```

lucas: I like soft->hard split. two notes: 1) for long-doc slices the baseline variance is higher — we should use slice-aware thresholds (e.g., allow larger margin for >2k tokens). 2) We should measure hallucination as hallucination_rate_per_1000_tokens, not per-inference, to normalize.

anya: Agreed on slice-aware. also request adding a confidence-weighted sample in the canary so human evals hit the edge cases early.

sam: What about cost signals? int4 reduces unit cost but if p95 latency jumps we might see more infra spend (autoscale). propose p95_latency_ratio_hard=1.2 and cost_per_token_delta > +10% triggers immediate rollback.

maya: Good call. let's add cost delta check. also add a quiet-burn mode: if multiple soft warnings across different metrics occur but none cross hard, pause ramp and run 10k additional shadow requests for deeper eval.

eval-bot: autopruned eval summary: shadow vs base @ 1% (2h):
- overall_mrr_delta: -0.009
- longdoc_mrr_delta: -0.018
- hallucination_rate: 1.22x
- p95_latency_ratio: 1.12x
- sample_size: 4.2k
(see https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/1750005555)

lucas: That longdoc_mrr_delta hitting -0.018 is close to hard for that slice. I recommend extend step_interval to 30m and pause next step while we gather more samples.

maya: I'm fine with that. revised plan: step_interval 30m, add slice override: longdoc.thresholds.delta_mrr_hard: -0.025. keep halluc_ratio_hard = 1.4 but for longdoc set 1.6.

anya: Also add human quick-check pipeline: route 50 failing-looking responses to QA for a 15-min manual pass at each step when longdoc slice has >0.015 drop.

sam: Implementation note: deployer will need to support "route-to:int8-bridge" fallback with seamless KV cache warmup. if we route to int8 we should warm a hybrid cache to avoid cold tail latency.

deploy-bot: deploy request: rollout-config uploaded to staging: /configs/rollouts/1750005555.yaml by maya. waiting for canary start. :rocket:

maya: starting canary now at 1%. will monitor dashboards and notifications. ping me if anything spikes.

eval-bot: alert (10m): longdoc_mrr_delta rolling window (30m) = -0.019, halluc_ratio = 1.24x, p95_latency = 1.11x. soft-fallback conditions met.

lucas: soft-fallback pls — route longdoc traffic for the flagged cohort to int8-bridge and hold global ramp.

maya: triggered soft-fallback. holding ramp and enabling extra shadow logging for the flagged cohort. :white_flag:

anya: Thanks — can teams add notes to the rollout thread when manual QA completes? helps downstream support.

maya: will do. moderately happy we caught early. follow-up: we should add an automated "pause and request additional N shadow samples" step in the pipeline so it's not manual next time.

sam: I'll open a tiny PR to the rollout engine to add that param (shadow_sample_target) and the slice overrides.

lucas: LGTM. good catch team. :thumbsup:

maya: closing loop — patch merged, soft-fallback executed, ramp paused. will reconvene after 24h of extra shadow.

deploy-bot: note: canary still at 1% (routing modified to int8-bridge for cohort). logs archived to https://console.redwood.ai/logs/1750005555

maya: thanks all.
